reason: The default mismatch is real: the CLI option defaults to 1 (src/sentry/consumers/__init__.py:432-437) while the factory and SpanFlusher default to None, meaning one process per shard (factory.py:41, flusher.py:47-51). It is a documented, overridable default that keeps the pre-patch single-flusher behaviour, and the tests part is overstated: test_flusher_processes_limit runs 2 processes over 4 shards (tests/sentry/spans/consumers/process/test_consumer.py:100-117).
